outcome.summary: DRAFT (medium): Slackers Bill Preston and Ted Logan must pass a history presentation or be split up—dooming a utopian future built on their music. Future agent Rufus lends a phone-booth time machine; they collect historical figures for a report and learn “San Dimas time” waits for no one.
